envelope.description: Enforce inclusive admission across the shared planner

body.title: Enforce inclusive admission across the shared planner
body.summary: Wire selected profiles before createReviewJob at code-review, grounded-review and template-review entries. Replace independent message-only checks in job, gather and duplicate adapters with the shared inclusive measurement. Correct required-neighbour and correction-dropping fallbacks; keep existing evidence-preserving split/gather protocol and envelope IDs.
acceptanceChecks: Single, chunk, retry, gather/reduce, relation, obligation and comparison/pair candidates all fit the same inclusive cap; no unmeasured schema/shared context is appended after admission.
All production entry points resolve provider/profile before job construction; test doubles supply explicit synthetic policies instead of production zero-cost defaults.
Required usage-neighbour evidence is never dropped to fit. Supported lossless partitioning is used or required-context-over-budget is explicit; optional context remains separately optional.
An oversized required correction is included in supported replanning or causes correction-budget-exceeded; the original uncorrected prompt is never silently reissued.
Frozen job policy survives continuation/config changes; no source evidence, dimension, relation or obligation is silently omitted under smaller payload allowance.

tests.name: src/workflow/review-pipeline/__tests__/pipeline-job.test.ts: inclusive single chunk retry admission and required-neighbour correction overflow retain all mandatory evidence
src/workflow/review-pipeline/__tests__/code-review-gather.test.ts: gather reduction relation obligation and duplicate comparison use the shared budget
src/workflow/review-pipeline/__tests__/entry-budget-profiles.test.ts: code grounded and template review resolve the selected profile before job construction
